## GET DIAGNOSTIC (QQ) PLOTS (Supplemental Figure 4)

```{r}

# Genomic inflation in EWAS
  ## Extract p_values for (M3/Health,SES,Behavior)
p_values9 <- rural_m3$P.Value
p_values10 <- schlyrs_m3$P.Value
p_values11 <- livegpar_m3$P.Value
p_values12 <- chsmk_m3$P.Value

  ## Extract lambda values (Model 3/Primary)
lambda_value9 <- calculate_lambda(p_values9)
lambda_value10 <- calculate_lambda(p_values10)
lambda_value11 <- calculate_lambda(p_values11)
lambda_value12 <- calculate_lambda(p_values12)


#Generate plots
  ## M3
qq_ruralm3 <- qq_plot2(p_values9, lambda_value9, "Grew up in a rural area")
qq_schlyrsm3 <- qq_plotschlyrs(p_values10, lambda_value10, "Years in school")
qq_livegparm3 <- qq_plot2(p_values11, lambda_value11, "Live with a grandparent")
qq_chsmkm3 <- qq_plot2(p_values12, lambda_value12, "Smoking during childhood")

# Combine
qq_plots3 <- plot_grid(qq_ruralm3, qq_schlyrsm3,qq_livegparm3, qq_chsmkm3, ncol = 2)

# Export
save_plot("Manuscript/Mar21_qq_plots_m3.png", qq_plots3, base_width = 18, base_height = 15, dpi = 1200, bg = "white")

```

## VOLCANO PLOTS (Figure 3) 

### CHILD RURAL

```{r}

 ## M3
#Plot
plot.volcano <- function(rural_m3,main=NULL,xlim=NULL,ylim=NULL, nudge=0, title=""){par(mar=c(5,5,3,3))
#get betas and pvals from single sites results
betas <- rural_m3$logFCpercent
pvals <- -log(rural_m3$P.Value,10)
#assign colors
pcol <- ifelse(pvals < -log(0.05,10), 'darkslategrey', ifelse(betas>0,'#558899','#559999'))
#get percent hyper/hypo for sites above threshold
total <- table(pcol)['#558899'] + table(pcol)['#559999']
pct <- c(round(table(pcol)['#558899']/total * 100,1),round(table(pcol)['#559999']/total * 100,1))
#auto calculate axis range if not defined
if(is.null(xlim)){
  max.x <- max(abs(betas))
  xlim <- c(-max.x-0.05, max.x+0.05)
}
if(is.null(ylim)){
  ylim <- c(0,ifelse(max(pvals)<7, 7, max(pvals)+0.5))
}
df <- data.frame(betas=betas, pvals=pvals, col=pcol)
  ggplot(df, aes(x=betas, y=pvals, col=I(col))) +
    geom_point(size = 0.5, show.legend = FALSE) + ggtitle(title) +
    geom_hline(yintercept=-log(0.05, 10),color='blue') +
    geom_hline(yintercept=7,color='red') +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted", color = "black") +
    annotate("segment", x = -0.12, xend = -0.9, y = max(ylim) - 0.2, yend = max(ylim) -0.2,
                 arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.5, "cm")), color = "black", size = 0.5) +
    annotate("segment", x = 0.12, xend = 0.9, y = max(ylim) - 0.2, yend = max(ylim) -0.2,
                 arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.5, "cm")), color = "black", size = 0.5) + 
    annotate("text", x = -1.0, y = max(ylim) -0.3, label = "Lower percent \n methylation", size = 10, hjust = 1.02) +
    annotate("text", x = 1.0, y = max(ylim) -0.3, label = "Higher percent \n methylation", size = 10, hjust = -0.02) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(title=element_text(size = 28), axis.text=element_text(size=25), axis.title = element_text(size = 28)) +
    xlim(xlim) + ylim(ylim) +
    xlab(paste0('Adjusted difference in percent DNA methylation')) + ylab(expression('-Log'[10]*'(P-Value)')) +
    annotate("text", x = xlim[2] - 0.02, y = 5.5, label = paste0(pct[1],'%'), color='darkslategrey', size = 10, fontface = 'bold', hjust = 1) +
    annotate("text", x = xlim[1] + 0.02, y = 5.5, label = paste0(pct[2],'%'), color='#558899', size = 10, fontface = 'bold', hjust = 0) 
}
volcano_rural3 <- plot.volcano(rural_m3, ylim=c(0,15.3), xlim=c(-5,5), nudge=0.015, title = "A. Grew up in a rural area")

#Get Number with Higher and Lower Methylation
fdrp <- rural_m3[rural_m3$adj.P.Val < 0.05,]
sig <- rural_m3$P.Value < 0.05
betas_sig <- rural_m3$logFCpercent[sig]
rural_higher <- sum(betas_sig>0, na.rm=T)
rural_lower <- sum(betas_sig<0, na.rm=T)
rural_total <- length(betas_sig)
pct_higher_sig <- (rural_higher/rural_total)*100
pct_lower_sig <- (rural_lower/rural_total)*100

cat("Higher Methylation N:", rural_higher, "(",round(pct_higher_sig, 2), "%)\n")
cat("Lower Methylation N:", rural_lower, "(",round(pct_lower_sig, 2), "%)\n")

```

## OUTPUT RESULTS TO TABLE

### M3 PRIMARY models

```{r}

cat("Top 20 significant CpG Sites for Association between Child Rural and DNAm: Adjusted for health, socioeconomic status, and behavior covariates")
top_cpgs_rural_m3 <- rural_m3 %>% arrange(P.Value) %>% head(10)

cat("Top 20 significant CpG Sites for Association between Years of School and DNAm: Adjusted for health, socioeconomic status, and behavior covariates")
top_cpgs_schlyrsm3 <- schlyrs_m3 %>% arrange(P.Value) %>% head(10)

cat("Top 20 significant CpG Sites for Association between Live with a Grandparent and DNAm: Adjusted for health, socioeconomic status, and behavior covariates")
top_cpgs_livegparm3 <- livegpar_m3 %>% arrange(P.Value) %>% head(10)

cat("Top 20 significant CpG Sites for Association between Child Smoking and DNAm: Adjusted for health, socioeconomic status, and behavior covariates")
top_cpgs_chsmk_m3 <- chsmk_m3 %>% arrange(P.Value) %>% head(10)


#Set up individual exposure tables
#Primary
top_cpgs_m3_ruraltbl <-  top_tbl(top_cpgs_rural_m3, "Top 20 significant CpG sites for Grew up in a rural area and DNAm: Adjusted for health, socioeconomic status, and behavior covariates")
top_cpgs_m3_schlyrstbl <- top_tbl(top_cpgs_schlyrsm3, "Top 20 significant CpG sites for Years in school and DNAm: Adjusted for health, socioeconomic status, and behavior covariates")
top_cpgs_m3_livegpartbl <- top_tbl(top_cpgs_livegparm3, "Top 20 significant CpG sites for Live with a grandparent and DNAm: Adjusted for health, socioeconomic status, and behavior covariates")
top_cpgs_chsmkdstbl <- top_tbl(top_cpgs_chsmk_m3, "Top 20 significant CpG sites for Smoking during childhood and DNAm: Adjusted for health, socioeconomic status, and behavior covariates")


gtsave(top_cpgs_m3_ruraltbl, "Manuscript/EWAS/top_ruraltbl_M32026Mar21.docx")
gtsave(top_cpgs_m3_schlyrstbl, "Manuscript/EWAS/top_schlyrstbl_M32026Mar21.docx")
gtsave(top_cpgs_m3_livegpartbl, "Manuscript/EWAS/top_livegpartbl_M32026Mar21.docx")
gtsave(top_cpgs_chsmkdstbl, "Manuscript/EWAS/top_chsmktbl_M32026Mar21.docx")


#Get nominally significant sites (p<0.0001)
ruralsig_p0.0001 <- rural_m3 %>% filter(P.Value < 0.0001) #49
schlsig_p0.0001 <- schlyrs_m3 %>% filter(P.Value < 0.0001) #574
livegparsig_p0.0001 <- livegpar_m3 %>% filter(P.Value < 0.0001) #23
chsmksig_p0.0001 <- chsmk_m3 %>% filter(P.Value < 0.0001) #20

all_exp_p0.0001 <- all_exposures %>% filter(P.Value < 0.0001) #650 (rura=30; chsmk=21; livegpar=23; schlyrs=576)
top_cpgs_by_exposure <- all_exp_p0.0001 %>% group_by(exposure) %>%
  arrange(P.Value, .by_group = TRUE) %>% slice_head(n = 20) %>% ungroup() 

#Save
sheets_p0.0001 = list('childrural' = ruralsig_p0.0001, 'SCHLYRS' = schlsig_p0.0001, 'LIVEGPAR' = livegparsig_p0.0001, 'CHSMOKE' = chsmksig_p0.0001)
write_xlsx(sheets_p0.0001, 'Manuscript/EWAS/Significant Sites P<0.0001.xlsx', format_headers = TRUE)

allexpsheets_p0.0001 = list('All exposures' = all_exp_p0.0001, 'By Exposure Top 20' = top_cpgs_by_exposure)
write_xlsx(allexpsheets_p0.0001, 'Manuscript/EWAS/Mutually Adjusted Exposure Significant Sites P<0.0001.xlsx', format_headers = TRUE)

```
